evidence.reason: The per-item helper calls `services.outbox.retained()` and linearly scans the retained records whenever the source key is not already cached in `queue.backfill_state_events`. When multiple newly acknowledged items are processed in one merge, each new source key repeats that full outbox read/scan. Building a per-pass source-key index and updating it after spooling is a local performance fix that preserves the existing reuse and retry behavior.
